name: zloc_format_message
description: zLoc::FormatMessage wraps Win32 FormatMessageA and leaves the output buffer unchanged on lookup failure. The operational zSys.cpp source field identifies only the current candidate compile host and does not establish historical zLoc filename or translation-unit provenance.
known_limits: The smoke verifies failure-path return and buffer preservation; success formatting is covered indirectly by callers that use the loaded message provider.
tier S verification remains pending for vararg formatting and FormatMessageA provider call shape.
